name: Rice County, MN
findings: Rice County has 279 nonprofit organizations. 133 of them (48%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 103 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (17% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, Rice County has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Hobby and sports organizations stand out for membership
observations.text: 12 hobby and sports organizations here list membership, compared with about 5 in similar places of this size.

confidence.text: Based on 12 organizations here; 29% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: What role do hobby and sports organizations play in community life here? Who do they reach, and who might they miss?

observations.title: Religious organizations that list no opportunities
observations.text: 13 religious organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity in their tax returns or on their websites. Many may still offer them without describing them there.

observations.title: More organizations list civic or political action
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in Rice County list civic or political action in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.8 times the typical level).
